name: WallaBee — GPS item-collecting game
demand: The public Google Play listing shows 10K+ installs, 163 reviews and a 3.9 rating; the US App Store page shows 76 ratings and 3.7. A third-party tracker counted 20,433 Android downloads on 2026-10-11, but that is not an audited user count. These are modest reach signals, not active-user evidence: DAU, MAU, payer count, retention, trade volume and search volume are unverified. The current store copy says 2,600+ items; Flippa says 3,000+, so ask for a dated catalog export. Sources: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wallabee-item-collecting-game/id1155134198 ; https://chrome-stats.com/d/com.wallabee ; https://flippa.com/11895309-a-gps-based-digital-item-collection-game-players-discover-rare-digital-treasures-trade-with-others-and-create-custom-collections-includes-in-app-purchases
prices: WallaBee is free to download with in-app purchases; its current purchase prices are not shown in the public listing. For category anchors, Geocaching’s US membership page lists $6.99 monthly or $39.99 annually, while Pokémon GO is free to download and play with optional in-app purchases. These are adjacent products, not direct price equivalents. Sources: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://payments.geocaching.com/membership ; https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-video-games/pokemon-go/

revenue_proof.claim: Flippa currently displays USD $2,064 monthly profit, an 84% margin, a USD $75,000 asking price and a 3.0x profit multiple. It says its team reviewed revenue, primary expenses and traffic, but the detailed financials require an account; the same page advises buyers that financials are seller-provided and to request source records. Monthly revenue, TTM revenue and TTM profit are not public. Treat the profit as an intermediary-reported seller claim, not independently evidenced revenue.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: Unverified. The page was live on 2026-10-23, but the month or accounting period behind the USD $2,064 claim is not stated; zero weight until dated records are supplied.

copy_speed: Adjacent collection loops have launched recently. CatchCat launched on Google Play on 2026-06-22, turning real-world cat sightings into collectible cards; an install tracker recorded 100,000+ installs by 2026-08-02 (tracker estimate, not audited). Garmin’s Radar - GPS Treasure Hunt first released 2026-09-08 with a collection of virtual treasures. These are not exact WallaBee clones, but they show that GPS discovery and collecting mechanics can be copied quickly; the older catalog and player network are the more defensible parts. Sources: https://dev.ua/en/news/catchcat-1782109586 ; https://www.androidrank.org/application/catchcat/xyz.catchcat.app ; https://apps.garmin.com/apps/557dcc34-ceb5-4bff-9b02-b601c5c96bf8
platform_risk: The public Google Play listing identifies Freeze Tag, Inc. as publisher, shows location-related gameplay and says the app was last updated 2025-08-15. Google supports formal app transfers, but the target’s eligibility and seller’s authority are unverified; Google says app users, data and statistics transfer, while historical earnings reports do not. Apple supports app transfers subject to eligibility and account requirements; its documentation notes that some integrations, keys and sign-in data need transfer work. Verify app IDs, store ownership, payment profiles, source code, database, hosting, map/API keys, push notifications, login systems, IAPs and location-data obligations before buying. Sources: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/6230247?hl=en-GB10-1 ; https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/transfer-an-app/overview-of-app-transfer/ ; https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/transfer-an-app/app-transfer-criteria/
defensible_asset: Provisional network-effect moat: the game combines a persistent collectible catalog with player trading, forums, item mixing and community leaders. The current store listing confirms forums and trade requests; Flippa describes over 3,000 items, chats and community leaders. The catalog and network are plausible assets, but current active-player density, trade liquidity, item ownership records and catalog transfer rights are unverified. The network may be weak if activity is sparse. Sources: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://www.wallabeegame.com/rules ; https://flippa.com/11895309-a-gps-based-digital-item-collection-game-players-discover-rare-digital-treasures-trade-with-others-and-create-custom-collections-includes-in-app-purchases
build_effort: This is an acquisition, so initial product build is avoided; ongoing technical takeover could still be substantial. The public listing does not disclose the repository, backend, deployment process or staffing. The Android release is more than a year old, and Freeze Tag’s 2024 annual filing described proprietary game engines built on shared technologies including Cordova and HTML5; that is historical context, not proof of the current stack, and makes shared-code rights and dependencies important diligence items. Sources: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://www.otcmarkets.com/filing/html?guid=LsZ-kqWDgxw-B3h&id=18330283
channel: Use app-store optimization, SEO, broad paid search/store ads, opt-in in-game referrals and inbound partnership listings or community collaborations; promote the game and its existing mascot/art rather than Ricardo’s personal brand. Do not use cold email, SMS, social DMs or calls. UK ICO guidance treats social DMs as electronic mail and generally requires consent or a limited existing-customer soft opt-in when marketing to individuals. Recheck platform and recipient-country rules before campaigns. Sources: https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/electronic-and-telephone-marketing/electronic-mail-marketing/ ; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guidance-on-direct-marketing-using-electronic-mail/how-do-we-comply-with-the-pecr-electronic-mail-marketing-rules/
owner_hours_per_week: Unverified. The public listing gives no owner-hours disclosure, so the <=5 h/week constraint cannot be confirmed. Source: https://flippa.com/11895309-a-gps-based-digital-item-collection-game-players-discover-rare-digital-treasures-trade-with-others-and-create-custom-collections-includes-in-app-purchases
automation_reason: My cautious estimate is 45%, with high uncertainty and below the required 50%. Agents could handle store/review summaries, FAQ drafts, support triage, analytics and routine catalog copy. Human oversight is still likely for engineering releases, login or trading disputes, moderation, location/privacy incidents and payment escalations. The listing’s claimed community leaders and CMS may reduce workload, but actual staffing, tickets and owner-time logs are undisclosed; the old app update date adds technical-maintenance uncertainty. Sources: https://flippa.com/11895309-a-gps-based-digital-item-collection-game-players-discover-rare-digital-treasures-trade-with-others-and-create-custom-collections-includes-in-app-purchases ; https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee
listing_check: HOLD; not ready to underwrite. Revenue: Flippa says it reviewed revenue, expenses and traffic, but public source statements and accounting dates are unavailable. Churn/retention: unverified. Owner hours: unverified. Price/profit: USD $75,000 divided by the listed USD $2,064 monthly profit annualized gives about 3.03x, close to Flippa’s displayed 3.0x; this uses a single undated monthly claim, not verified TTM profit. Transferability: Google Play and Apple have app-transfer mechanisms, but this app’s eligibility, credentials, backend and IAP handover are unverified; Google says historical earnings reports stay with the original account. Seller dependence: Flippa hides the seller identity, while current Google Play and App Store pages identify Freeze Tag, Inc. as publisher. Require proof of sale authority and rights to the brand, code, catalog, server, data and shared services. Sources: https://flippa.com/11895309-a-gps-based-digital-item-collection-game-players-discover-rare-digital-treasures-trade-with-others-and-create-custom-collections-includes-in-app-purchases ; https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wallabee-item-collecting-game/id1155134198 ; https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/6230247?hl=en-GB10-1 ; https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/transfer-an-app/overview-of-app-transfer/
moat_assessment: Passes the original cheap network-effect check, but only provisionally. Trading, forums, a maintained item catalog and community leaders can create network value and switching costs for collectors. The public evidence does not establish current trade liquidity or active-member counts, and the listing’s item count must be reconciled with the store’s 2,600+ description. Treat the moat as real but unquantified until seller data shows active users, trades, catalog ownership and player retention. Sources: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://www.wallabeegame.com/rules ; https://flippa.com/11895309-a-gps-based-digital-item-collection-game-players-discover-rare-digital-treasures-trade-with-others-and-create-custom-collections-includes-in-app-purchases
desk_test: No-cost, one-day go/no-go: install the public app and test account creation, login, nearby item density from Bromley, trade/forum flows and the IAP screen without purchasing. In the same day, request a seller screen-share of read-only Play Console/App Store Connect revenue, installs and active-user/retention reports for the latest TTM; reconcile payouts and expenses to source statements, and inspect owner time logs, support/moderation volume, app IDs, repository, backend and transfer permissions. If the seller cannot show dated financials, churn/activity and chain-of-title, do not proceed. Sources: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallabee ; https://flippa.com/11895309-a-gps-based-digital-item-collection-game-players-discover-rare-digital-treasures-trade-with-others-and-create-custom-collections-includes-in-app-purchases
red_flags: Flippa’s monthly-profit claim has no public accounting date or TTM proof; churn and owner hours are absent. The seller is confidential, but both stores name Freeze Tag, Inc. as publisher, so authority and asset scope are critical. App update history shows last Android update 2025-08-15. Freeze Tag’s historical filing described shared proprietary game technology, which could create transition or licensing dependence if still applicable. One source says 3,000+ items and current stores say 2,600+; request the actual catalog export.
